common.copied_desc: The barcode was copied to clipboard.

onboarding.slide1_desc: Point the camera at any barcode and autofill product data almost instantly.
onboarding.slide2_desc: Manage your offline catalog. Your data is protected and saved securely on your device's memory.
onboarding.slide3_desc: Generate backups to your local storage, Google Drive, or share them via WhatsApp and Email.

home.title: BarCode Inventory
home.subtitle: Read barcodes, complete product information, and keep your inventory accessible anytime.
home.scan_new_desc: Identify and save items to inventory using your back camera.
home.view_catalog_desc: Consult, edit, or delete the products saved on this device.
home.manual_reg_desc: Type the product code or name if you prefer not to use the camera.
home.tip_body: Products you have already scanned open directly from the local database. Internet connection is only used to search for entirely new items.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage backups, database, and preferences for your application.
settings.export_local_desc: Create a .db copy in the Files folder
settings.backup_tip: Note: Google runs an invisible automatic backup of up to 25MB of this app to the cloud, provided Android backup is enabled.
settings.reset_alert_desc: This will permanently delete all saved products on this device and reset the onboarding screen. Are you sure?
settings.reset_success_desc: Data has been erased. The application will restart now.

catalog.empty_desc: Scan or manually register products to build your offline catalog.
catalog.empty_alert: Register at least one product before exporting.
catalog.delete_msg: Do you want to remove "{{name}}" from the catalog?

manual.title: Manual Registration
manual.subtitle: Use this when the product does not have a readable barcode or isn't on Open Food Facts.
manual.req_msg: Please provide at least the barcode and product name.
manual.invalid_price_msg: Enter a valid numeric value, like 12.90.

scanner.permission_msg: We need access to your camera to scan barcodes.
scanner.not_found_msg: We couldn't find this barcode. Do you want to register it manually?
